title: pfizer-opensource/nf-crispr-primer-design pipeline parameters
description: Primer design for sequencing CRISPR target sites

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to input file (tab-delimited text) with guide ID and sequence columns.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved.

prefix.description: Prefix added to the output file names.

keep_all_columns.description: Keep all input columns in output file

reference_genome_options.title: Reference genome options
reference_genome_options.description: Reference genome related files and options required for the workflow.

igenomes_ignore.description: Do not load the iGenomes reference config.
igenomes_ignore.help_text: Do not load `igenomes.config` when running the pipeline. You may choose this option if you observe clashes between custom parameters and those supplied in `igenomes.config`.

igenomes_base.description: The base path to the igenomes reference files

coding.description: Include coding exon definitions in the amplicons.yaml file.

id_col.description: Column of input containing the guide ID

seq_col.description: Column of input containing the guide sequence

chr_col.description: Column of input containing the chromosome of the guide if already determined

pos_col.description: Column of input containing the genomic position of the guide if already determined

strand_col.description: Column of input containing the genomic strand of the guide if already determined

size_range.title: Amplicon size range(s)
size_range.description: Space-separated list of amplicon size ranges ('min-max') to use for primer design. Ranges listed earlier are preferred over later ranges

target.title: Target window
target.description: Number of base pairs centered on the guide that must be included within the amplicon

flanking.title: Flanking region
flanking.description: Number of base pairs on either side of guide to search for primer designs

num_pairs.title: Number of primer pairs
num_pairs.description: Number of primer pairs to design per guide

max_poly_x.description: Maximum allowed length of a mononucleotide repeat in a primer

ngs_adapters.description: Name of NGS adapters to append to primers, or none to not add adapter sequences.

ngs_min_n.description: Minimum number of N bases to include in NGS primer design to add early read complexity.

ngs_max_n.description: Maximum number of N bases to include in NGS primer design to add early read complexity.

ngs_max_length.description: Maximum NGS primer length with adapter and N's for early read complexity.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.
